Collections aus Plex (Vorschau, Detailan: Collections from Plex (preview, detail view, import check), new start view “In Plex, poster missing”, settings with a sidebar (or as a list on mobile), keyboard shortcuts, shorter update notice, new app icon and many improvements. Full details under “What's new” and in the CHANGELOG.
Das kleine Icon im Browser-Tab ist jetzt: The small icon in the browser tab is now the new one too (browsers cache old icons for a very long time; the addresses now carry the version number). If the old one still shows in the tab: reload the page once or clear the site data.
Im Abzeichen unten rechts fliegt jetzt e: The badge at the bottom right now shows an orange flame comet (a nod to Kometa) – built the same way as the p5converter icon, which has an audio CD and a Blu-ray. It also appears in the README and in the Unraid template. On iPhone/iPad, delete the web app from the home screen once and add it again to get the new icon.
Das Icon hat jetzt ein kleines Abzeichen: The icon now has a small badge with a fireball (comet) at the bottom right, and the “p5” is slightly smaller. This tells p5assets apart from p5converter (which uses two arrows); the layout is the same for both. Also applies to the home screen app on iPhone/iPad and to Unraid. On iPhone/iPad, remove the web app once and add it again to get the new icon.
p5assets startet jetzt mit „In Plex, Pos: p5assets now starts with “In Plex, poster missing” – what shows up in Plex without an image. “Missing” is now “All missing”, and the “Not in Plex yet” tab is gone (those titles keep their label and appear under “All” and “All missing”).
Auf dem iPhone und iPad im Hochformat si: On iPhone and iPad in portrait mode, settings are a grouped list; tapping an entry opens its page. Onboarding shows “Step x of y” with a progress bar.
Die Poster in der Collection-Ansicht sin: Posters in the collection view are smaller on mobile, and hidden collections are listed by name in the settings.
Beim Schließen der Detailansicht bleiben: When you close the detail view, the posters stay in place instead of briefly turning black and reloading.
Unter Einstellungen → Bibliotheken lässt: Under Settings → Libraries you can expand the list of hidden collections; you can unhide each one individually.
Die Poster-Vorschau eines Films nennt se: A movie's poster preview shows its Plex collection. One click opens the collection's detail view with all its posters, which you can replace or upload there just like for a series.
Einrichtung und Einstellungen haben jetz: Setup and settings now have a sidebar with groups instead of the long tab bar.
Die Reiter „Vollständig“ und „Collection: The “Complete” and “Collections” tabs are gone (“All” is enough), and “Upload images” is now called “Upload posters”.
Große Sammel-Collections, die keine Film: Large catch-all collections that aren't film series can be hidden. The import shows all matching collections of a movie, not just the first.
Beim Import zeigt die Prüfung die Plex-C: During import, the check shows a movie's Plex collection and whether any movies in the collection are still left without a poster afterwards.
Ein Klick auf „p5 assets“ oben bringt di: Clicking “p5 assets” at the top takes you back to the home page from anywhere.
“/” jumps to the search field, Esc clears it. In the poster preview, the left/right arrow keys switch to the previous or next poster.
Dateien wie „… Collection“ oder „Box Set: Files like “… Collection” or “Box Set” are no longer matched to a title automatically. For tiles with two matches, the check prefers the file “Title (Year)”.
Nach einem Update erscheint nur noch ein: After an update, only a short notice appears. You can find all the news at any time in the footer under “What's new”.
Schütze p5assets optional mit Benutzerna: Optionally protect p5assets with a username and password. Forgot your password? With access to the server, you can reset it.
p5assets meldet sich per Discord, Telegr: p5assets notifies you via Discord, Telegram or ntfy when there are new titles without posters (marked Coming Soon) or when a scan fails.
Lädst du ein Serien-Set oder eine ZIP mi: If you upload a series set or a ZIP with several series, p5assets groups the images by series and checks whether all seasons from Plex/Sonarr are included. Tiles with two matches are flagged and must be resolved first.
Ersetzte und gelöschte Poster bleiben 30: Replaced and deleted posters stay in the trash for 30 days. After every action, “Undo” appears; the trash icon in the header shows the full list.
Findet Poster-Ordner, zu denen es weder: Finds poster folders that have no matching title in Plex or in Sonarr/Radarr and, after confirmation, moves them to the trash.
Neuer Reiter für zu kleine oder nicht 2:: New tab for posters that are too small or not 2:3. You choose the thresholds yourself.
Im Statistik-Block zeigt eine kleine Kur: In the statistics block, a small curve shows how your world's coverage develops from scan to scan.
Die Farbe einer Welt wählst du jetzt aus: You now pick a world's color from a grid of ten worlds, each with its own planet – and switching is a little trip through a wormhole.
Kein Häkchen-Kästchen mehr auf den Poste: No more checkbox on the posters; only “missing” is marked. One “Not in Plex yet” badge instead of “not released” and “no file”. Search now sits next to the tabs (with ✕ to clear), “Upload images:” offers file/ZIP and folder, and the trash has its own icon.
Dort öffnet sich das Original in p5asset: There, the original opens in p5assets (long-press the image → “Add to Photos”) instead of the iOS file viewer with no way back. ZIP downloads are available on desktop only.
Auf iPhone und iPad: Teilen → „Zum Home-: On iPhone and iPad: Share → “Add to Home Screen”. p5assets then launches full screen with its own icon. To refresh, pull down at the top of the page or tap “Reload” at the bottom.
In der Online-Suche und in der Serien-De: In the online search and in the series detail view, p5assets opens the search on ThePosterDB; you then simply drop the downloaded set here.
Eigene Ordner für Titel ohne Plex/Sonarr: Custom folders for titles without Plex/Sonarr/Radarr no longer exist. Folders you already created appear under “Orphaned folders” and can be cleaned up there.
p5assets startet jetzt auf Englisch. Mit: p5assets now starts in English. Use the “$ EN/DE” switch in the header to change the language; your choice is remembered in the browser.
Die bunten Emojis sind durch Terminal-Ze: The colorful emojis are replaced by terminal characters like “[ OK ]” and “$ ready_” so everything fits the Matrix style.
